check.crew_note: Oxygen hissed loudly at the regulator, was just the cylinder valve not seated, fine now. Supervisor looked it over, signing at handover.

defects.desc: Regulator leak, closed by crew without a workshop job.
Latch sticks on the equipment locker door.

deciding.defects_controlled: The main oxygen leak was marked closed by the crew with no workshop job, and its deferral expired 2025-09-03, before the shift date. The critical item is therefore not validly resolved.
deciding.readiness_status: The only open item is a sticking locker latch, which is minor. All sections are signed and the drugs are in date, so release leads. The unverified oxygen closure leaves some doubt.
deciding.limiting_area: The service margin is 268 km, the morphine expiry is 20 days out, and the only open item is a latch. The unverified oxygen closure, a clinical item, is the only thing pulling towards clinical_equipment.
deciding.check_completeness: All 3 sections are signed and countersigned_by is null, which makes level 2. The crew note says the supervisor reviewed it and is signing at handover, which keeps level 3 plausible.
deciding.defect_severity: The open locker latch sits between cosmetic and a fitting. The desc says it sticks on the equipment locker door, which holds level 1 and level 2 in balance.
